scheme_name: Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or continuous residence for not less than 5 years
Annual income of the applicant must not exceed ₹24,000
The widow must not be receiving assistance or grant under any other scheme implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Puducherry
Up to two dependent children of the widow are eligible
Each child must be a student enrolled in an institute approved/recognised by the Government of Tamilnadu, Government of Kerala, or Government of Andhra Pradesh for technical examinations
Each child must have passed/appeared for SSLC/Matriculation or an equivalent examination recognised by the Education Department, Puducherry
Each child must be studying typewriting and/or shorthand
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50 per month as tuition fee reimbursement, up to ten months per child and for a maximum of two children.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self-attested, if required)
